crossRefs.note: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.
Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and…
Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for…
Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great…
The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we.…
He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”
translations.bsb: Now the king of Aram was at war against Israel. After consulting with his servants, he said, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”
translations.kjv: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
translations.asv: Now the king of Syria was warring against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
